meta.title: Thesis Mode
meta.description: A quiet LaTeX workspace: source editor, PDF builds, and reviewed AI edits through your Harness chat and models.

folio.libraryLead: Write LaTeX beside its PDF, with an assistant that proposes — you decide.
folio.noProjects: No manuscripts yet. Start one on the left.
folio.deleteProjectConfirm: Move this manuscript out of the library? Its folder is kept in .trash on disk.
folio.deleteFileConfirm: Delete this file? This cannot be undone.
folio.selectFile: Pick a file from the left to start writing.
folio.binaryFile: This file is not editable as text.
folio.noPdfHint: Compile to typeset your manuscript. ⌘/Ctrl + S saves and compiles.
folio.renameMainExtension: The main file must keep the .tex extension. Choose another main file first to change the file type.
folio.renamePendingExtension: Resolve this file's pending proposal before changing its extension.
folio.conflict: The file changed since this suggestion was made. Ask the assistant to try again.
folio.chatHint: Ask about your manuscript, revise a passage, or fix a build error. Edits arrive as suggestions you review.
folio.renderFailed: Folio could not draw this workspace
folio.chatUnavailable: The writing chat did not become available. Try again, or start a new chat.
folio.dragHint: Drag to move · drop at an edge to dock · double-click to float or dock
folio.texEnvLead: Folio compiles with the TeX distribution on this computer. It looks in the folder you choose, then Harness's PATH, then the usual install locations.
folio.texPackagesOk: All common packages (amsmath, hyperref, tikz, biblatex, ctex, …) are installed.
folio.texInstallAfter: After installing, click Re-detect. If it still isn't found, enter its bin folder below.
folio.texTesting: Rendering test documents… the first Biber or LuaLaTeX run can take half a minute.
folio.importHint: A .zip (for example an Overleaf download) or a folder. Drop it here or choose one.
folio.importDropHint: Drop a .zip file or a folder.
folio.pasteBlocked: The browser blocked pasting from here. Use ⌘V / Ctrl+V.
folio.syncUnavailable: Compile once more to jump between the source and the PDF.
folio.syncNoMatch: This line has no position in the PDF.
folio.editorZoomHint: Tip: pinch or Ctrl/⌘ + scroll over the source to change the size; ⌘0 resets.
folio.unsavedBlocked: This file has changes that could not be saved. Resolve them first: reload the file or keep your version.
folio.replaceFilesConfirm: These files already exist in the manuscript and will be replaced
folio.contentsInserted: Table of contents inserted. Compile the PDF to see it.
folio.contentsFound: Located the existing table of contents.
folio.contentsUpdated: Contents depth and entries updated. Recompile the PDF to see them.
folio.pdfLocateMode: Locate source (click the PDF when enabled)
folio.pdfInternalLink: Go to the linked location in this PDF
folio.referencesClear: No missing or duplicate reference keys found.
folio.referenceNoMain: Choose a main source file in the compile menu first.
folio.goToBody: Go to the start of the body
folio.checkNeedSelection: Select the LaTeX source you want to check.
folio.checkTooLong: Select up to 20,000 characters to check.
folio.checkClear: No common syntax or spelling issues found in the selection.
folio.checkChanged: The source changed. Select the text and check again.
folio.checkLimited: Showing up to 40 issues. Narrow the selection to continue.
folio.checkUnclosedBrace: Opening brace has no matching closing brace
folio.checkUnexpectedBrace: Closing brace has no matching opening brace
folio.checkUnclosedEnvironment: Environment is missing its closing command
folio.checkUnexpectedEnvironment: Closing command has no matching opening command
folio.checkEnvironmentMismatch: Closing command should match the opening environment
folio.checkUnclosedMath: Math mode is missing the closing delimiter
folio.checkUnexpectedMath: Closing math delimiter has no matching opening delimiter
folio.noImages: Upload a figure in the Files pane first
folio.caption: Caption
folio.tablePasteHint: First row is the header. You can paste cells from Excel.
folio.invalidTable: Use at least two rows with equal columns, up to 12 columns and 40 rows.
folio.noCitations: No entries found in project .bib files
folio.scopeChanged: The file or selection changed. Choose the scope again.
folio.scopeHelp: Choose only the sources needed for this task. You review every proposed change.
folio.validationCancelled: Validation cancelled. Source was not changed.
folio.validationFailed: The patch failed validation. The source and last valid PDF were preserved.
folio.previewPublishFailed: The validated change was saved. Recompile to update the preview.
folio.undoConflict: The file has changed since application. Undo was blocked.
folio.formattingReview: This passed the limited formatting check. Review the diff before approving.
folio.protectedReview: This patch changes protected content or structure. Review the diff and authorize the write to enable approval and validation.
folio.authorizePatchWrite: I reviewed the diff and authorize writing this patch
folio.uncertainReview: The plugin could not determine whether this patch changes content. Review the diff and authorize the write to enable approval and validation.
folio.tableGridPaste: Paste at least two rows copied from a spreadsheet into any cell to fill the grid.
folio.tablePasteInvalid: Paste 2–40 rows, up to 12 columns and 500 characters per cell.
folio.tableNeedsData: Enter a header and at least one row of data.
folio.invalidFormatLabel: Start the label with a letter or number. Letters, numbers, colons, dots, underscores and hyphens are allowed.
folio.labelNeedsCaption: Add a caption so the label refers to the correct figure or table number.
folio.invalidFigureWidth: Enter a whole number between 5 and 100.
folio.figureAddGraphicx: Also load graphicx in the main file's preamble
folio.figureCheckGraphicx: No explicit graphicx import was detected in the main file. Add it to the preamble if your template does not load it.
folio.figureUploadHint: Upload a PNG, JPEG or PDF to the project's images folder.
folio.invalidFigureFile: Choose a PNG, JPEG or PDF with a LaTeX-compatible file name.
folio.figureExists: The images folder already contains this name. Select the existing image or rename the new file.
folio.insertPreamble: The cursor is in the preamble. Insert this content in the document body.
folio.insertAfterBody: TeX ignores content after the end of the document.
folio.insertNoBody: Could not find the document body in the main file. Check \begin{document}.
folio.insertComment: Move the cursor or selection out of the comment before inserting.
folio.insertMath: Move outside the formula before using this tool.
folio.insertLiteral: Move outside the code or literal environment before inserting.
folio.insertFloat: Move outside the current float or restricted environment before inserting.
folio.insertGroup: Move the cursor or selection outside the command argument or environment marker.
folio.tableMerged: Unmerge the cells in the first worksheet before importing.
folio.tableFormula: The sheet contains an error or a formula without a saved result. Recalculate and save the values in Excel first.
folio.tableImportError: Could not read the table. Choose an .xlsx or UTF-8 CSV file.
folio.tableValuesOnly: Raw values from the first visible worksheet or CSV. Check dates and numbers.
folio.tableBooktabsMain: No explicit booktabs import was found. This table uses compatible spacing and rules. To load booktabs, open Templates in the main file.
folio.formulaInvalid: This formula cannot be previewed. Check the commands, braces and subscripts.
folio.formulaPreviewEmpty: Enter or paste LaTeX to see a preview here.
folio.formulaVisionHelp: Paste a screenshot or choose a handwritten photo. The image is sent to the current DSH model provider. Select a model that accepts images in chat, then copy its LaTeX reply here to check it.
folio.formulaImageInvalid: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image under 5 MiB.
folio.formulaNeedChat: Close this dialog, open a DeepSeek conversation and select a model that accepts images, then return here.
folio.formulaBusy: The current conversation is responding. Wait before sending the image.
folio.formulaSent: Image sent. Copy the LaTeX reply, then open Formula to confirm and insert it.
folio.templateAlreadyPresent: No fragment is available. Open a .tex file or choose another fragment.
folio.templatePreambleHint: Adds only packages without an explicit import before the document body in the main file.
folio.templateBodyHint: Inserts at the cursor or after the selection and preserves existing text.
folio.templatePlacement: Close the dialog and move the cursor to a valid insertion point.
folio.formatAnchorChanged: The file or cursor position changed. Select the insertion point again.
folio.lowerTogether: Show files and chat side by side
